correctness.rationale: Direct cyclic shift equations for the ordinary closed-neighborhood game eliminate the inner press vector. Explicit identities the two displayed factorisations over the binary field give the gcd-kernel dimension; coprime periodic subspaces and unique normalization exhaust all kernels. The six finite enumerations each inspect 2, 32, 4, 64, 16 or 256 base patterns; independent exact full GF(2) Gaussian elimination and codeword enumeration verifies 150 admissible graphs through n=80. The proof covers n beyond that by periodicity, not by empirical extrapolation. All six coefficients sum to 2^(h+4delta).

originality.rationale: Most relevant exact-graph 2016 paper was read in full: its Table 1 already contains finite nullities n<=40 and those are not claimed as new. Its Theorem 11 addresses singularity and it gives no quiet-code Hamming-weight enumerator. A 2012 binary-matrix note provides general context, and a 2024 generalized Petersen paper is a different, move-restricted two-player Nimbers problem. Three targeted semantic research-record searches found no semantic match for weight distributions; residual potential unindexed literature is stated.
